summary: Snowmobiler Bill DeLaCroix broke his right femur in two places in a crash at the edge of a powder field ~10 miles into the Rabbit Ears Pass backcountry around 3 p.m. the day after Thanksgiving. With the group out of cell range in near-zero temperatures, companions built a fire; two rode toward the Buffalo Pass towers to reach cell service while DeLaCroix triggered his SPOT beacon. Routt County SAR arrived from Steamboat ~10 minutes before a Flight for Life helicopter from Frisco, which flew him to St. Anthony's Hospital in Frisco for surgery that night.
location: Rabbit Ears Pass backcountry, near Buffalo Pass towers
responding_agency: Routt County Search and Rescue; Flight for Life
notes: First-person account signed by the victim (forum user "OLD GOAT", thread posted 2010-12-16); fills Routt County zero-row year 2010.
